outline:
Course contents include the following topics:
1. Design of fundamental linear adaptive filtering algorithms
2. Performance analysis of adaptive filtering systems
3. Design of nonlinear adaptive filtering algorithms
4. Distributed adaptive filtering systems
5. Study recent research papers related to adaptive filtering algorithms
schedule:
(a) Week(b) Topics

1: Course Introduction
2–5: Design and Performance Analysis of LMS Adaptive Filtering Algorithms
6–8: Design of Kernel Adaptive Filtering Algorithms
9: Midterm Examination
10–11: Distributed Adaptive Filtering Systems
12–14: Paper Reading and Discussion
15–16: Final Project Oral Presentations

Flexible Learning Weeks (Schedule and Assessment):
17: Independent Study / Final Written Report
18: Independent Study / Final Written Report

flexible_learning.outcome:
1. Understand the Fundamentals of Adaptive Signal Processing

5. Develop Research and Analytical Skills

assessment:
This course adopts a flipped classroom approach. Students are required to complete assigned readings before class and participate in in-class presentations and discussions.

Grading policy:

1. Paper Study 40%
2. Final Report 40%
3. Course Interaction 20%
